outcome: Need for postcesarean anticoagulation for VTE prophylaxis
cohort: A total of 1134 postcesarean women, aged 18-55 years, who underwent a cesarean section at a tertiary-level care hospital.
finding: Anticoagulation needs assessment tools vary extensively in their estimations for postcesarean VTE prophylaxis, with the percentage of patients qualifying for prophylaxis ranging from 0.5% (ACOG) to 90.9% (RCOG).
